title: On the Nature of Sarcophagite — First Observations

pages.text: The differential hath been confirmed thrice over, and I will not call it instrument error again. At 0.003 hz the sarcophagite does not merely stand apart from the grey stone's singing — it answers in the contrary direction, as a shadow answers light. We have named it inert these many years. We were describing our own incuriosity.

I have set the census records against the bell-tuning ledgers of the last four great surveys. The correspondence is there to be read by any eye that will look. R. says I catastrophise. R. has not looked at the ledgers. R. looks instead at the window, at the hills, at the ordinary afternoon, as though ordinariness were evidence of safety.
